title: Close the server acceptance gaps
acceptance:
Story: the 0.1 server must meet the promises already recorded for WI-14, WI-16 and WI-18 before PI 2 builds on it.
Expected: deleting an empty folder removes it; a failed home setup leaves the invitation unused and the account uncreated so the same invitation retries successfully, including first-run admin; a CI test reads openapi.yaml, calls every documented operation and validates every documented response status against its schema.
Not expected: new features, a browser client, or changes to the public API shape.
Depends on: WI-14, WI-16, WI-18.
Verify: the server suite and the contract suite pass, including the new regression cases, and the v0.1 launcher acceptance passes.
evidence: Implemented and QA-passed on 26 November 2026. createHome creates the member home and its profile before the account row, removes it on a database failure, and leaves the invitation unclaimed on a home failure; first boot logs admin-provision-failed synchronously and exits nonzero before any admin key, with zero account rows, then succeeds on retry. DELETE uses rmdir, mapping ENOTEMPTY/EEXIST to 409 and other errors to 404, so an empty folder returns 200 and disappears from the listing. openapi.test.mjs parses openapi.yaml, exercises all 12 operations and 40 documented response statuses, validates each body against its schema, asserts set equality and PATCH 405, and fails on an undocumented status or a silently dropped section (9 paths, 12 operations, 40 statuses pinned). Observed: server and contract tests 14/14, 0.2 verify.py passed, 0.1 verify.py passed, npm test 12/12, validate ok with 44 records. Independent QA on GLM 5.3-Flash returned PASS with three low non-blocking notes: unknown directory errors answer 404, a hard crash can leave an orphan home, and the validator does not reject extra properties. The increment merged in PR #6 at 3bc4565; these fixes are in follow-up PR #7: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/7.
